# Candela & Café Market

> Neighborhood café, NY-style deli and Dominican kitchen with a small market at 507 N Miami Ave, Downtown Miami. Open every day from 8 am, with wine and live music on Fridays.

## About

**Candela & Café Market** (on Google as "Candela y Café Market") is a café, deli and market in Downtown Miami: "Born in NY, raised Dominican, served in Miami."

- **Website:** https://candelaycafe.com
- **Menu:** https://candelaycafe.com/menu
- **Address:** 507 N Miami Ave, Miami, FL 33136 (Downtown Miami)
- **Phone and WhatsApp:** +1 (786) 254-7577
- **Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/candelaycafe/
- **Delivery:** [Uber Eats](https://www.ubereats.com/store/candela-y-cafe-market/oa35cIfwWWuJm-ND4o9G1g) and [DoorDash](https://www.doordash.com/store/candela-y-caf%C3%A9-market-miami-26069377/)

## Hours

- Sunday to Tuesday: 8 am to 10 pm
- Wednesday to Saturday: 8 am to 11:30 pm

## What we serve

### Breakfast, coffee and juices
From 8 am: coffee, fresh juices, breakfast and bakery.

### NY deli
Sandwiches from the New York deli. Favorites: The Ruben Sandwich, Candela Burger, Chopped Cheese and Grilled Chicken Panini.

### Dominican food
Dominican food from the hot table, made every day.

### The market
Basics and natural products to take home.

### Fridays
Wine, coffee until close and live music from 8 pm. Tables are reserved on WhatsApp.

## How to order

- From the online menu: the order is sent on WhatsApp.
- Delivery through Uber Eats or DoorDash.

## Common questions

- **Where are you?** At 507 N Miami Ave, Downtown Miami, FL 33136.
- **What are your hours?** Sunday to Tuesday, 8 am to 10 pm. Wednesday to Saturday, 8 am to 11:30 pm.
- **Do you deliver?** Yes, through Uber Eats and DoorDash. You can also order from our menu on WhatsApp.
- **Is there live music?** Every Friday from 8 pm, with wine and coffee until close. Reserve your table on WhatsApp.
- **What kind of food do you serve?** NY deli sandwiches, Dominican food made every day, breakfast, coffee and fresh juices, plus a small market with basics and natural products.
